_note_cover: The manuscript's only picture is a finished cover mock-up (Ministry crest, title, ZEPH logo baked in) whose footer icons are labelled in Cinyanja (Muetserani, Lankhulani, Werengani, Lembani), not Kiikaonde - so it is not used as-is. The classroom scene is cut out of it at the series cover card's own 122:78 shape, so the card shows every child whole: x 66-782, y 392-850 of the 847x1024 original. The pink 'BUUKU WA MUFUNJISHI' banner that sat on the wall above the teacher is painted out to plain wall (white, as the wall is), keeping her hair. Real-ESRGAN x4: 716x458 -> 2864x1832, ~596 DPI at 122mm. The engine draws the title, book type, byline and logo itself. The manuscript's own copy of the mock-up is dropped from the inside.
_note_authors: The cover-page leftovers ('Musoyo Racheal', 'KIKAONDE', 'Curriculum Development Centre, 2025') were read as three authors. The imprint names one author, spelt Racheal both times.
_note_remove: BIJI MU BUUKU is the heading of the author's hand-typed contents list (the entries themselves are dropped by the engine); the engine prints its own Table of Contents.
_note_lessons: A lesson-plan Teacher's Guide (MUTWE / BYAKETEKELWA KUBIWA / MUFUNJISHI / BAFUNDA ...): lessonLabels bolds the labels and restarts numbered steps under each one, as in the Kiikaonde Grade 1 TG.
